name: dsfd_wfc_vmx_w-p1-COMMIT
purpose: S81 sp_wfc priced kit (VM_LINK 1 / POSTED 1 / RD2 1 / VMRQ 64 / WOUTW 8): the WFC -> VM write / START half of dsfd_wfc_vmx as its own leaf (the one-tile vmx is ~66k flops on two roots at these parameters; rq64w8 / rd2s routes stalled). Pin flops, pre-queue, fast -> slow ratio FIFO, write issue + START doorbell, write skid + grant link, credit return, the kit fault register, the HEP start register. Two related clocks ck 1.2 GHz / ckv 0.9 GHz (crossings flop -> flop at the 278 ps window; roots balanced by wfc_ser_ref.tcl). Cycle-exact with the one-tile kit in the cluster lockstep bench.

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; dsfd_wfc_vmx_w u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/mtp/dsfd_wfc_stg_cl.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/mtp/dsfd_mtp_tops.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/mtp/ot_dsrom_mtp_skid.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/mtp/ot_dsrom_mtp_link_pair.sv rtl/common/ot_ratio_cdc_fifo.sv && echo lint-ok

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/dsfd_wfc_vmx_w/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/dsfd_wfc_vmx_w/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/dsfd_wfc_vmx_w --out {RUN}/record/views/dsfd_wfc_vmx_w  > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run
